_meta.spelling_policy: English spellings follow the Macross Wiki (macross.fandom.com) article title, or the infobox 'english' field where the wiki contradicts itself. Japanese names are given given-name-first in English. Variants in 'avoid' must not appear in the translation; the proofreading script replaces them with 'en'.

fields.en: Canonical English spelling to use in the translation
fields.ja: Japanese name as written in Japanese media (in-game form when known)
fields.aliases: Other legitimate names, callsigns or nicknames that may appear in dialogue
fields.avoid: Wrong or non-canonical romanizations that must be replaced with 'en'
fields.gender: From the wiki. Never infer gender from a name
fields.status: verified = English spelling and facts taken from the wiki page; needs_check = conflicting or thin sources, see notes
fields.af_uses: How many Ace Frontier text entries (EBOOT, mission scripts, unit lists) contain the Japanese name or one of its ja_aliases. 0 = not in the dumped text; the name can still be heard in voice clips
fields.muf_role: Role in Macross Ultimate Frontier, kept from the MUF glossary
fields.af_role: Role in Ace Frontier: pilot (playable) / pilot table (AI or enemy) / operator / player pilot slot / mentioned / not seen

_meta.ja_caveat: 'ja' and 'ja_aliases' come from the MUF glossary and were checked against the AF text dump (af_uses). Entries for series that are not in AF (Macross Zero apart from names, Macross II, VF-X2, Dynamite 7) were dropped when AF never names them.
_meta.game_source: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/マクロスエースフロンティア
_meta.seeded_from: Macross Ultimate Frontier glossary 0.1.0 (sister project, same engine), pruned and extended for Ace Frontier

characters.personality: Devout and serious guardian of the island's traditions; distrustful of outsiders and their technology at first.

characters.position: Major (the game's Zero-era briefings already call him Major); Skull Squadron leader

characters.ja: ノーラ・ポリャンスキー
characters.position: Captain, Anti-U.N. ace pilot (wine-red SV-51γ), Ivanov's wingmate
characters.personality: Vengeful and sadistic in combat; hates U.N. soldiers, who massacred her family. Merciless.

characters.position: Anti-U.N. ace pilot and squadron leader (SV-51); Roy Focker's former instructor
characters.personality: Ruthless and calculating, disillusioned with the U.N.; cares only for his partner Nora.

characters.position: Civilian stunt flyer turned U.N. Spacy VF-1 pilot; Vermillion Flight leader, later Skull Squadron leader

characters.notes: Wiki title uses 'Ichijyo' (also lists 'Ichijo' as alias). Robotech names (Rick Hunter etc.) must never be used.

characters.position: Nyan-Nyan waitress turned idol singer (Miss Macross)

characters.af_role: pilot table (AI or enemy, not playable)

characters.position: SDF-1 Macross bridge officer. The game uses army-style ranks: 中尉 'Lieutenant', 大尉 'Captain' (decided in dialogue review 2026-10-15).
characters.personality: Stern, by-the-book officer with a strong sense of duty; clashes with free-wheeling pilots, especially Hikaru.
characters.notes: Later Misa Ichijyo; use Hayase for the 2009 story.

characters.ja: マクシミリアン・ジーナス
characters.position: 2009: genius VF-1 pilot, Vermillion Flight. 2045: Captain of the Macross 7 / Battle 7
characters.personality: Reserved, gentlemanly genius ace who never brags. As captain he is calm and composed.
characters.notes: Called 'Max' by friends. In Macross 7 he is the fleet captain ('Captain Max'/'Kancho'). AF has the SDF-era pilot and 'Max (7)', the Macross 7 fleet commander.

characters.personality: Happy-go-lucky joker who joined up to be popular with girls; rushes in to rack up kills.

characters.ja: ミリア・ファリーナ・ジーナス
characters.position: 2009: Zentradi ace pilot (Queadluun-Rau), defects and marries Max. 2045: Mayor of City 7
characters.personality: Proud warrior who refuses to lose; remains strong-willed after defecting.
characters.notes: Spelling confirmed by user 2026-10-15. Called 'Milia 639' in DYRL. Before marriage (2009 TV) she is 'Milia Fallyna'. Wiki article title is 'Milia Farina Jenius' but the wiki body, game roster page and series sources use 'Fallyna': using 'Fallyna'. AF has three playable versions: SDF-era pilot 'Milia Fallyna' (before marriage), 'Milia (Micronian)' and Macross 7 mayor 'Milia (7)'.
